verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in Workers observability (logs) and event subscriptions that publish account events to a queue for custom consumption. Nothing in the pack documents a native alerting or notification feature that sends chat or email messages when conditions are met. Event subscriptions and the Agents SDK's email/Slack connectors are developer building blocks a user could use to construct alerting, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
